rubric_items.reason: Uses only the existing layers: router, service, repo, client.ts, PatientsPage and the existing index. No new endpoint, no migration, no infrastructure. Follows the UTC/HOSPITAL_TZ rule and the list envelope rule.

S-1 to S-4 each map to components. Every AC is covered: latest COMPLETED, the Asia/Kolkata date with an API-level AC3 test, '-' for null, paging/search/sort/Next unchanged, no sort option, no highlight, and no medical columns.

The method and path are exact. The new field is exact: last_visit: string | null, YYYY-MM-DD in HOSPITAL_TZ. The JSON and TS shapes are given for both type files, and HOSPITAL_TZ is passed as a bound parameter.

The name and format of last_visit are now listed under Assumed with their basis. The list row types in api/src/types.ts and web/src/api/types.ts are still uncited and are not in the module map. Assumed does not mention them.
Five trade-offs, each with a reason and a cost: date string vs instant, DB vs browser, derived vs stored, reusing the endpoint (including the picker latency cost), and selecting only the date.
Clear and consistent. Endpoints now have their own section, matching the frontmatter. The 'harmless' wording is gone.
